info.name: Compute Cloud@Customer Compute Cloud At Customer API
Gets a list of all Compute Cloud@Customer infrastructures in a compartment

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which to
list resources.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description:
Default is false.
When set to true, the hierarchy of compartments is traversed and all compartments and
sub-compartments in the tenancy are returned. Depends on the 'accessLevel' setting.

params.name: accessLevel
params.description:
Valid values are RESTRICTED and ACCESSIBLE. Default is RESTRICTED.
Setting this to ACCESSIBLE returns only those compartments for which the
user has INSPECT permissions directly or indirectly (permissions can be on a
resource in a subcompartment). When set to RESTRICTED permissions are checked and no
partial results are displayed.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter used to return only resources that match the given lifecycleState.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the entire display name given.

params.name: displayNameContains
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose display name contains the substring.

params.name: cccInfrastructureId
params.description:
An [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) for a 
Compute Cloud@Customer Infrastructure.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.
